first_party_annotation.label: Ray Sang’s Annotation
first_party_annotation.scope: New first-party descriptions and review notes only to the extent rights exist and are controlled; excludes facts, titles, third-party text, prior grants and legal/platform exceptions.

claims.bounded_premise: The examined state guidance uses economic-resources/full-accrual reporting for fiduciary statements and separates additions and deductions from a cash-flow statement.
claims.source_model_limit: Selected presentation and resource-flow discussion only; classification is to be stipulated. Exclude local fund codes and dollar thresholds, enterprise exception, and component-unit classification rules.

claims.bounded_premise: A liability to a beneficiary depends on an event compelling disbursement; assumed receipt or available cash alone is not the teaching trigger.
claims.source_model_limit: Selected presentation and resource-flow discussion only; classification is to be stipulated. Exclude local fund codes and dollar thresholds, enterprise exception, and component-unit classification rules.

claims.bounded_premise: A qualifying in-substance defeasance funded only with existing resources removes the debt under the economic-resources focus and recognizes the carrying-versus-reacquisition difference.
claims.source_model_limit: Existing-resource in-substance defeasance only. Trust qualification requires separate evidence and will be stipulated, not inferred from payment. No new-debt refunding or Texas amortization thresholds.

claims.bounded_premise: The corresponding existing-resource payment is a debt-service expenditure under the current-financial-resources focus.
claims.source_model_limit: Existing-resource in-substance defeasance only. Trust qualification requires separate evidence and will be stipulated, not inferred from payment. No new-debt refunding or Texas amortization thresholds.

claims.bounded_premise: For an already qualifying obligation, the selected method measures expected outlays at current value, with a corresponding deferred outflow.
claims.source_model_limit: Economic-resources measurement for an already qualifying obligation only. Exclude source tank scenario and figures, local account codes/thresholds, conditional obligations, landfill and pollution-remediation scope decisions.

claims.bounded_premise: Later relevant current-cost changes adjust the obligation and, before retirement, the deferred outflow; that deferred amount is expensed systematically over the applicable asset-life period.
claims.source_model_limit: Economic-resources measurement for an already qualifying obligation only. Exclude source tank scenario and figures, local account codes/thresholds, conditional obligations, landfill and pollution-remediation scope decisions.

claims.bounded_premise: An already recognized OREO held-for-sale asset uses a cost-versus-fair-value-less-selling-costs measurement boundary.
